gaps.explanation: Statement p5 'Transfer from (to) other funds' Total Governmental Funds column prints (1,056,846), net of the transfers between governmental funds: General Fund (1,648,252) + Street Fund 529,331 + Joint Fire Fund 62,075 = (1,056,846). Detail records the General Fund transfers out gross from the departments schedule p14 (General (1,587,993) + Fire (37,759) + Ambulance (22,500) = (1,648,252), equal to the statement's General Fund column), and the Street (p11) and Joint Fire (p13) transfers in as Transfers In. Difference 1,648,252 - 1,056,846 = 591,406 = 529,331 + 62,075, the intra-governmental transfers netted in the Total column. Gross vs net presentation only; no fix.
